items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tony Sparbaro. Tony Sparbaro. Tony Spargo he calls himself now. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

Tony Sparbaro. Tony Sparbaro. Tony Spargo he calls himself now. Tony Sabarbara.
